+@pytest.mark.parametrize('has_results', [False, True])
+def test_query_cache_update_order(db, has_results):
+    table = db.table('table3', cache_size=3)
+    if has_results:
+        table.insert_multiple({'int': value} for value in range(4))
+
+    queries = [where('int') == value for value in range(4)]
+    results = table.search(queries[0])
+    for query in queries[1:3]:
+        table.search(query)
+
+    table._query_cache[queries[0]] = results[:]
+
+    assert table._query_cache.lru == [queries[1], queries[2], queries[0]]
+
+    table.search(queries[3])
+
+    assert table._query_cache.lru == [queries[2], queries[0], queries[3]]
+    assert queries[1] not in table._query_cache
+    assert table.search(queries[0]) == results
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("setter", ["set", "__setitem__"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("initial_value", [1, 0, False, None, "", [], {}])
+def test_lru_cache_set_existing(setter, initial_value):
+    cache = LRUCache(capacity=3)
+    cache["a"] = initial_value
+    cache["b"] = 2
+    cache["c"] = 3
+
+    getattr(cache, setter)("a", 4)
+
+    assert cache.lru == ["b", "c", "a"]
+    assert len(cache) == 3
+    assert cache["a"] == 4
+
+    getattr(cache, setter)("a", 5)
+
+    assert cache.lru == ["b", "c", "a"]
+    assert len(cache) == 3
+    assert cache["a"] == 5
+
+    cache["d"] = 6
+
+    assert cache.lru == ["c", "a", "d"]
+    assert "b" not in cache
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("capacity", [0, 1, 3, None])
+def test_lru_cache_capacity(capacity):
+    cache = LRUCache(capacity=capacity)
+    for key in range(5):
+        cache[key] = key
+        start = 0 if capacity is None else max(0, key + 1 - capacity)
+        assert cache.lru == list(range(start, key + 1))
+        assert len(cache) == len(cache.lru)
+
+    if cache:
+        oldest = cache.lru[0]
+        expected_order = cache.lru[1:] + [oldest]
+        cache[oldest] = 0
+        assert cache.lru == expected_order
+        assert cache[oldest] == 0
+
